summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K (home-market equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) on October 30, 2026, reporting Q3 2026 production/sales and progress on commercial bank debt restructuring. Definitive restructuring agreements with Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. cover roughly 58.4% of commercial bank senior debt. Q3 V2O5 output fell to 2,093 tonnes from 2,636, with first by-product copper, gold, platinum and palladium production; sales held at 2,428 tonnes. Production guidance was cut to 9,500–10,500 tonnes. No board recommendation or advisor named.
